baselines.label: 20260928-2400s
baselines.summary: A 2400-second ASTRA reconstruction run with four exported review iterations.

3.conclusion: The initial proposal was rejected. FoundationPose drifted onto the keyboard after frame 300, while a mesh-basis mismatch and hallucinated bowl prongs produced a mean silhouette IoU of 0.056.

5.conclusion: The repaired geometry and trajectory fixed the global failure and raised mean silhouette IoU to 0.647. Ambiguous axial rotation and contact-depth intervals still required temporal refinement.

8.conclusion: Object rotation became continuous with a 5.84° maximum step, but averaging independent hand-depth choices crossed high-penetration states around frames 379 and 652–667. This contact regression was rejected.

9.conclusion: Temporal DP preserved low-penetration contact branches without averaging through the hand. The complete reconstruction was accepted with mean silhouette IoU 0.618 and a sampled maximum penetration estimate of 9.05 mm; known thin-bowl roll errors remain disclosed.
